defect: The change dropped the '|| key.publicParts().isEmpty()' clause, so encrypted ASN.1/PEM keys (whose public part is only available after decryption) are no longer opened when decrypt is false, breaking their removal from ssh-agent.
reason: The fix restores exactly the clause this change removed (with the renamed publicKey()).

defect: The fix makes autoTypeSequence() treat a matching window association with an empty sequence as a match instead of returning an empty string.
reason: The faulty 'if (sequence.isEmpty()) return QString();' was added by the later commit f4a4930f; in this change an empty association sequence correctly fell back to the default sequence.

defect: The fix ignores close requests while the open widget is still unlocking the database, preventing a crash.
reason: The crash comes from the pre-existing closeEvent guard (!isLocked() && !lock()) letting a close through during unlock; the added resetQuickUnlock() call is kept by the fix and is not the cause.

defect: The fix changes result.reserve(result.size()) to reserve(pwEntries.count()), a capacity hint that has no effect on behaviour.
reason: Reserving zero is only a missed optimisation, not a wrong result, crash or leak, so the 'typo' fix is cosmetic.

defect: getBaseDomainFromUrl/getTopLevelDomainFromUrl/isIpAddress are compiled only under WITH_XC_NETWORKING, but BrowserService (WITH_XC_BROWSER) calls them, so a browser-enabled build without networking fails to build.
reason: The functions were moved out of BrowserService into this new file behind a narrower ifdef; the fix widens the guard to include WITH_XC_BROWSER.

defect: The clear-clipboard timeout read from config is in seconds but is passed to QTimer::start() as milliseconds, so the clipboard is cleared after ~10 ms instead of 10 s.
reason: This change introduced reading the timeout from config and passing it directly; the fix multiplies by 1000.

defect: The fix replaces a C-style cast (char*)image.bits() with reinterpret_cast<const char*> to silence a cast warning.
reason: The code worked correctly; the fix only addresses a compiler warning (style).

defect: Using a signed char for 'ch < 0x20' makes every byte >= 0x80 negative, so the repair strips all multi-byte UTF-8 characters from the XML.
reason: The new repair loop added in this change has the signedness bug; the fix casts to quint8.

defect: Replacing the per-iteration local error TextStream (flushed on destruction) with the global buffered Utils::STDERR and a plain "\n" means 'Unknown command' errors in interactive mode are not flushed and do not appear.
reason: The fix's error-message part changes this line to endl; the use-after-free part (cmd->currentDatabase not reset) was pre-existing, but the missing-output defect lies in lines this change wrote.

defect: setPlainText(password.toHtmlEscaped()) shows HTML entities (e.g. &) for plain-text passwords, and setting the font after setHtml/setPlainText does not give the password a monospace font.
reason: Both defects are in lines this change added; the fix drops toHtmlEscaped() and moves setFont() before setting the text.

defect: focusNextPrevChild dereferences qApp->focusWidget() (widget->parentWidget()) without a null check, crashing when the application has no focus (e.g. during saves).
reason: The new focus-sequence loop added in this change dereferences a possibly null pointer; the fix adds the null check.

defect: The new yubiKeySlot parameter is unused when WITH_XC_YUBIKEY is off, which with -Wextra and -Werror (debug builds) breaks compilation.
reason: This change added the parameter and used it only inside #ifdef WITH_XC_YUBIKEY; the fix adds Q_UNUSED in the #else branch.

defect: The DACL size adds GetLengthSid(pOwnerRightsSid) but not another sizeof(ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE) for the new owner-rights ACE, so the ACL buffer is too small when three ACEs are added (with WITH_XC_SSHAGENT).
reason: The size calculation line was changed in this change for the newly added ACE; the fix adds the missing sizeof.

defect: connect(parent, SIGNAL(lockedDatabase()), ...) names a signal that does not exist (DatabaseWidget emits databaseLocked()), so the TOTP dialog never closes on lock.
reason: The connection was added by this change; the fix corrects the signal name, which only DatabaseWidget.h reveals.

defect: The fix constructs the KeePass1 KDF as QSharedPointer<AesKdf>::create(true) to use legacy AES-KDF mode.
reason: AesKdf had no legacy-mode constructor at this commit; the need arose when b04c8c2 later split AES-KDF into KDBX3/KDBX4 variants, so the default here was correct when written.

defect: The fix changes QCOMPARE(m_db->kdf()->rounds(), Q_UINT64_C(123456)) to compare with an int literal to fix a test compilation error.
reason: The Q_UINT64_C comparison against an int rounds() already existed before (with 100); this change only changed the value, and it is a test-only fix.

defect: Initialising CGEventFlags (an enum type in the OS X 10.11 SDK) from 0 and from the int constants shiftKey/cmdKey/optionKey/controlKey does not compile on El Capitan.
reason: The CGEventFlags variables were introduced by this change; the fix adds explicit CGEventFlags(...) conversions, which only the SDK header shows are needed.

defect: QByteArray('\x7E', 32) and QByteArray('\x4B', 32) call QByteArray(int size, char ch) with swapped arguments, producing a 126-byte key and a 75-byte AES-256 seed, so the benchmark runs on wrong-sized data.
reason: The benchmark thread was added in this change; the fix swaps the arguments to QByteArray(16, ...) and QByteArray(32, ...).

defect: The fix refreshes the search results after deleting entries in search mode (preventing a crash) and factors the search refresh into refreshSearch().
reason: The crash is in deleteEntries, which this change did not touch; its cloneEntry lines were only refactored into refreshSearch().

defect: The fix makes the preview panel and search follow model changes through signals, removing explicit refreshSearch()/preview updates from deleteEntries and emptyRecycleBin.
reason: This is a restructuring of how views update; the removed preview-update code was already there before this change, and no defect in its new selection lines is repaired.

defect: The new keyPressEvent consumes Enter/Return without passing it to QTreeView, so the view no longer emits activated(), which AutoTypeSelectDialog relies on.
reason: The fix makes keyPressEvent always call QTreeView::keyPressEvent; the dependency is only visible in AutoTypeSelectDialog.

defect: The added else branch sets loadDb = false for any non-matching device name, so an earlier match is overwritten (e.g. IfDevice 'A,B' never opens on A).
reason: The fix removes this else branch and reworks the default; the faulty branch was added by this change.

defect: The fix connects the settings Apply button to saveSettings() and stops emitting editFinished from saveSettings/reject.
reason: This change only replaced Q_EMIT with emit; the apply-button behaviour is unrelated and pre-existing.

defect: The fix deduplicates KDBX4 inner-header binaries on read and write so attachment indices match; it also drops the AesKdf.h include.
reason: This change only added an include; the attachment-mapping problem comes from the KDBX4 writer, not from these lines.

defect: The fix replaces m_binaryPool with an inverse map so the reader skips duplicate binaries written by a buggy writer.
reason: Indexing binaries by position follows the KDBX4 format; the mismatch comes from the writer (ef8751a) emitting duplicates, and the reader change is a tolerance workaround.

defect: writeAttachments writes every attachment occurrence to the inner header, while KdbxXmlWriter numbers only unique attachment data, so attachment references point to the wrong binaries when data is duplicated (e.g. in history).
reason: The fix deduplicates writes in this new function; the index scheme it must match lives in KdbxXmlWriter::generateIdMap.

defect: The fix calls openEntryUrl() from the linkActivated lambda and guards disconnect() against null pointers, so clicking URLs in the preview works again.
reason: Link clicks broke because the later commit dfee5974 added disconnect(m_currentEntry), which with a null entry drops the preview's own signal connections; the focus lambda added here was only merged.

defect: The fix reworks the open widget UX (delayed password clearing, key file line edit) and removes the m_isOpeningDatabase guard as no longer needed.
reason: This is a UX redesign; it does not repair a defect in this change's lines, the guard is removed as redundant.

defect: QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QDesktopServices::AppDataLocation) uses a non-existent QDesktopServices enumerator (and the QDesktopServices include was removed), so non-X11 builds such as Mac fail to compile.
reason: The line was written by this change; the fix uses QStandardPaths::AppDataLocation.

defect: The fix replaces concatenated ' byte, ', ' rows, ', ' columns' strings with translatable plural forms (%n).
reason: This is a localization improvement, not a functional defect.

defect: Inserting 'Use Virtual Keyboard' at menu index 3 on Windows shifts the actions, so updateActionMenu's hard-coded actions[3..5] enable/disable the wrong items.
reason: The insertion was added in this change while the index-based updateActionMenu stays in view in the diff; the fix tags actions by property and inserts the virtual action after the indexed ones.

defect: The product-ID CFNumber is created from &vendorId instead of &productId, so device matching uses the vendor ID as the product ID.
reason: A copy-paste typo in the new file; the fix uses &productId.

defect: isValidUuid rejects UUIDs whose RFC 4122 version field is unknown, but KeePass entry UUIDs are arbitrary 16 random bytes, so valid entries are rejected and browser integration breaks.
reason: The new function added the version check; the fix removes it.

defect: The fix wraps the Database returned by readDatabase in a QScopedPointer to stop a memory leak in the test.
reason: The leak was introduced here, but only in test code, and the instructions class test-only fixes as no.

defect: The X11 includes are guarded by WITH_XC_AUTOTYPE while the code uses WITH_XC_X11, and config-keepassx.h is not included, so WITH_XC_X11 is undefined and X11 global shortcuts/capslock detection are silently compiled out (and the guards mismatch).
reason: The fix includes config-keepassx.h and uses WITH_XC_X11 consistently, both in lines this change added.

defect: A raw pointer to qApp->focusWidget() is stored across QApplication::processEvents() and the save, then dereferenced, crashing if that widget was deleted meanwhile.
reason: This change added the raw focus-widget pointer; the fix makes it a QPointer.

defect: The fix drops const from the stub's getSerial() and challenge() to match the YubiKey.h declarations.
reason: At this commit the header still declared these methods const, so the stub matched; the header was changed later (70816f90 and related commits), and this change only reformatted the signature.

defect: On WM_POWERBROADCAST the code treats lParam as a POWERBROADCAST_SETTING without checking wParam == PBT_POWERSETTINGCHANGE, dereferencing a null lParam when the system goes to sleep.
reason: The new event filter added in this change has the unchecked dereference; the fix checks wParam and null.

defect: The lock file path now uses fileInfo.canonicalPath() before the file is written, which is empty for a new file, so the lock file lands in the wrong place.
reason: This change moved lock-file creation before the save; the fix uses absolutePath() for a file that does not exist yet.

defect: KEEPASSXC_MAIN_WINDOW dereferences qobject_cast<Application*>(qApp) without a null check, crashing when qApp is not an Application (e.g. in unit tests).
reason: The macro was added by this change; the fix makes it return nullptr when the cast fails, and only the tests' QApplication shows the failure.
